answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 260 aliases needs 260 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The fable is the check that cannot be faked, the quartz is the price the attacker pays, and the comet is the record that outlives the epoch.
